source:
flowchart LR
  req[요구사항] -->|명세| plan[계획]
  plan -->|작업 목록| change[변경]
  change -->|변경 내역| verify{검증}
  verify -->|테스트 통과| approve[사람 승인]
  verify -->|실패, 3회 미만| fix[원인 분석과 수정]
  fix -->|수정 후 재검증| verify
  verify -->|실패 3회| escalate[에스컬레이션]
  approve -->|승인| done[완료]
  approve -->|거절| stop[종료]
english:
flowchart LR
  req[Requirements] -->|Specification| plan[Planning]
  plan -->|Task list| change[Editing]
  change -->|Diff| verify{Verification}
  verify -->|Tests pass| approve[Human approval]
  verify -->|Failure, fewer than 3| fix[Diagnose and revise]
  fix -->|Verify after revision| verify
  verify -->|3 failures| escalate[Escalation]
  approve -->|Approved| done[Complete]
  approve -->|Rejected| stop[Stop]
alt: Coding workflow with verification, retry limits, human approval, and escalation.

source:
flowchart TD
  conv[논문 변환] -->|Markdown 본문| model[모델 구현]
  model -->|모델 코드| train[학습 구현]
  train -->|학습 코드| smoke{스모크 테스트}
  smoke -->|통과| review[사람 확인: 탐색 범위와 예산]
  smoke -->|실패| diag[원인 진단]
  diag -->|모델 쪽 원인| model
  diag -->|학습 코드 쪽 원인| train
  diag -->|논문에 없는 설정, 또는 같은 원인으로 3회 실패| human[사람 판단]
  human -->|설정 결정 후| model
  review -->|승인| tune[하이퍼파라미터 튜닝]
  tune -->|튜닝된 설정| exp[비교 실험]
english:
flowchart TD
  conv[Convert paper] -->|Markdown text| model[Implement model]
  model -->|Model code| train[Implement training]
  train -->|Training code| smoke{Smoke tests}
  smoke -->|Pass| review[Human review: search space and budget]
  smoke -->|Fail| diag[Diagnose cause]
  diag -->|Model issue| model
  diag -->|Training code issue| train
  diag -->|Missing setting, or 3 failures with the same cause| human[Human judgment]
  human -->|After choosing settings| model
  review -->|Approved| tune[Hyperparameter tuning]
  tune -->|Tuned settings| exp[Comparison experiment]
alt: Paper implementation workflow with smoke tests, diagnosis, human review, and tuning.
